title: Azure — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Azure.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Outdoor Built." Specialty tier. Azure makes outdoor kitchen components — grills, refrigeration, and accessories at mid-range pricing. Good value for outdoor kitchen builds.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Azure:

• Mid-range outdoor kitchen components

• Good value stainless construction

• Full outdoor kitchen lineup

• Growing dealer availability

• Accessible entry to built-in outdoor cooking
